contact.basis: Unmodified public relief field sampled at the middle of the temple footprint.

verticalDatum: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM; orthometric height relative to EGM2008.
attribution: Contains modified Copernicus DEM data, European Union and Airbus Defence and Space
method: Original Copernicus COG band sampled bilinearly at the native pixel centres into a fixed local north-aligned field. No local leveling, outlier editing, or building-aligned fitting.
limitations: Native source pixels are about 28 by 31 metres. The field describes island relief and cannot resolve courtyard paving and stair levels. As a surface model it can include canopy and structures.

The initial Terrarium composite returned extreme below-river values and an inconsistent flattened western approach. It was excluded before model geometry; the Copernicus tile comes from a different source and is retained unmodified.
